description: Declarative detector table for lane-S capability discovery. A new capability kind is added by writing a row here (and a detector module only when the observation-pattern language below cannot express it). The policy gate and resolution layer consume these rows as data.

detectors.description: Business can be reached by phone
detectors.valueRule: phone-shaped value required; displayValue used VERBATIM, never normalized for display

detectors.description: Business can be reached by email
Business accepts contact/quote requests through its own form

gateParams.formActionMustBe: same-origin as source OR allowlisted handler (formspree.io, typeform.com); anything else fails safety

detectors.valueRule: form action must be a valid https URL; project-scoped fields (estimate/quote/project/service) promote kind to quote.request
booking provider host must be on the allowlist
signup endpoint must be a valid https URL

detectors.description: Business can be visited at a physical address

patternLanguage.factRefs: free-form stage-3 fact references; match by prefix or exact
patternLanguage.note: INFERRED and UNKNOWN observations NEVER produce candidates, by construction.

reviewQueue.description: Detector ideas that cannot be expressed deterministically do NOT become code here. They become review-queue entries resolved by a human or owner attestation, never silent auto-resolution.
